fees.note: Visa fee refunded only if visa not approved by Embassy

requirements: Taken looking straight forward
Face clearly visible
Printed on good quality paper

documents.name: Original Passport
documents.notes: Submit old passports also if any.
requirements: More than 2 blank pages
Minimum 6 months validity from date of travel

documents.name: Itinerary in Japan
documents.description: Detailed itinerary in Japan in official format
requirements: Always good to add flight landing and departure Information in the itinerary
Always good to add hotel checking in and checking out Information in the itinerary
Itinerary should be consistent with the flight and hotel reservations
Always good to mention transportation medium if travelling to multiple cities
The whole itinerary should be possible and make sense

documents.name: Cover Letter
documents.description: Personal cover letter explaining purpose of travel to Japan
documents.notes: Strongly recommended for better clarity of application
requirements: Any special circumstances to be explained clearly in the letter

documents.name: Passport Size Photograph
documents.description: One photograph taken within last 6 months

documents.name: Passport photocopy
requirements: Should be self attested with signature
documents.notes: Photocopy of the Bio Data Page of current passport (First and Last Page)

documents.name: Flight Reservations
documents.description: Document to show the flight/cruise schedule to/from destination
documents.notes: Applicant should include flight reservation details for arrival and departure from Japan.
requirements: Must match with itinerary plan in Japan
Applicant name must match passport

Applicant doesn't have to confirm the flight/cruise booking by paying upfront. They can submit a reservation with free cancellation and confirm it after visa approval to avoid losing money in case of visa rejection

documents.name: Hotel Reservation
documents.description: Hotel booking reservation for the stay in Japan
documents.notes: Applicant should include hotel booking reservation, Airbnb reservations, or any other accommodation details for entire stay
requirements: Must cover entire duration of stay in Japan
Applicant name must match passport
Accommodation address and contact details should be visible
Always good to add the dependent name in the reservation if sponsoring anyone

Applicant doesn't have to confirm the hotel booking by paying upfront. They can submit a reservation with free cancellation and confirm it after visa approval to avoid losing money in case of visa rejection

documents.name: Latest Income Tax Return
documents.description: Latest Income Tax Return(ITR) for last 2 years
documents.notes: Either ITR or bank statement (last 6 months). A4 size photocopy.
requirements: Bank statement of last 6 months
Should not be taken print out from bank website.
Get bank statement and balance certificate from your bank branch
Providing both ITR and bank statements are always a good idea

documents.name: Salary Slips (Last 3 Months)
documents.description: Latest salary slips for the last 3 months
documents.notes: [RECOMMENDED] to submit company-issued salary slips with company seal/signature if available
requirements: Must include applicant name
Must clearly show salary credited
Should cover last 3 months

documents.name: Bank Statement (Last 3 Months)
documents.description: Personal bank statement for the last 3 months
documents.notes: IF ITR is not available, INCLUDE A LETTER mentioning the reason for not submitting the ITR.
requirements: Should be stamped and signed by the bank branch
Should cover last 3 months
Must show sufficient balance
Online printouts without bank attestation are not accepted

documents.name: No Objection Certificate (NOC)
documents.description: NOC or leave approval letter from employer/School/College
requirements: Must be issued on company letterhead
Should mention applicant name and passport number if possible
Should confirm designation and employment status
Should clearly mention approved leave dates
Should include HR/manager signature and company stamp if available

documents.name: Parent/Spouse Income Tax Return
documents.description: Latest Income Tax Return of parents/spouse or bank statement of last 6 months if student/dependent
documents.notes: Required only if applicant is student or dependent. A4 size photocopy.

documents.name: Sponser Bank Statement (Last 3 Months)
documents.description: Sponser bank statement for the last 3 months
documents.notes: IF ITR is not available, INCLUDE A LETTER mentioning the reason for not submitting the ITR.
requirements: Should be stamped and signed by the bank branch
Should cover last 3 months
Must show sufficient balance
Online printouts without bank attestation are not accepted

documents.name: Proof of Relationship
documents.description: Proof of relationship if applicant is accompanied by dependent
documents.notes: Can be passport copy, marriage certificate, or birth certificate or any other document proving the relationship

documents.name: Consent from SPONSER
documents.notes: Required only if applicant is a student or dependent

importantNotes: All photocopies should be on A4 size only
